english.meaning: for a thought or memory to come back to you
english.note: 想起返上來 means it comes back to mind. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Ah, just as it was coming back up, I heard a pop.
exampleSentences.traditional: 啊，正想起返上來嘅時候就啪一聲啊，聽到。
